hotspots.title: Adorni scandal deepens
hotspots.blurb: Manuel Adorni, Argentina's Chief of Staff, resigned amid allegations of illicit enrichment, including undeclared assets and questionable expenses. His departure follows intense scrutiny from judicial investigations and political pressure, marking a significant crisis for President Javier Milei's administration.
hotspots.affect: This scandal commands disproportionate attention due to its erosion of public trust in Milei's anti-corruption narrative and the government's stability.

hotspots.title: AfD ban debate intensifies
hotspots.blurb: Germany's far-right Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) faces growing calls for a ban due to alleged unconstitutional activities. Legal opinions and petitions supporting a ban have gained significant traction, while AfD's rising poll numbers and internal leadership changes fuel the debate.
hotspots.affect: This debate commands attention due to its implications for democratic norms, the rise of far-right politics, and the potential for political instability in Germany.

hotspots.title: Vox-PP coalition tensions rise
hotspots.blurb: Tensions between Spain's Vox and Partido Popular (PP) are escalating over coalition agreements in regional governments. Vox threatens to withdraw support if PP fails to meet agreed-upon policies, particularly on issues like LGBTQ+ rights and deregulation.
hotspots.affect: This hotspot commands attention due to its impact on regional governance, the potential for political instability, and the broader implications for Spain's political landscape.
